description: Unofficial experimental app-local WireGuard proxy patches for YouTube and YouTube Music. WireGuard patches selected by default; tunneling stays off until profile import and explicit in-app enablement. Built from v2.1.0; v2.1.1 uses a verified two-byte class-file default flag update, without a full Gradle recompile or on-device testing. Standard release; experimental functionality, not a system VPN.
